name: rapidmqi
description: Masonry Quality Index (Borri & De Maria) from a photograph, parameter by parameter, in the browser
author: Giovanni Castellazzi <giovanni.castellazzi@unibo.it> (DICAM, University of Bologna)
comment: No dependencies and no build step, on purpose -- the same choice as
aLOTofImaginArches, whose interface kit this application vendors. docs/app
is plain ES modules served as-is by GitHub Pages, so the source a student
reads is the source that runs. This file exists so that Node knows the .js
files are modules, to name the test command, and to offer `npm start`.
The test script passes no path on purpose: `node --test tests/*.test.js`
relies on the SHELL to expand the glob, which cmd.exe does not do.
